tag_desc.rollout/episode_reward: Mean total reward per episode collected during rollout.
tag_desc.rollout/avg_energy: Energy remaining at the end of the rollout.
tag_desc.rollout/episodes: Episodes inside one 2048-step rollout (lower = longer episodes).
tag_desc.rollout/bootstrap_value: GAE bootstrap value used when the rollout cut mid-episode.
tag_desc.ppo/rollout_length: Transitions used in the PPO update.
tag_desc.eval/trained_reward: Mean reward of the trained policy on eval episodes.
tag_desc.eval/random_reward: Mean reward of the uniform-random baseline.
tag_desc.eval/trained_success: Fraction of eval episodes the trained policy survived to max_steps.
tag_desc.eval/random_success: Fraction of eval episodes the random baseline survived.
